item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Modi used emergency powers, surveillance, or anti-terror tools narrowly and lawfully in a way that offset the coercive record. The clearest evidence points the other way: shutdowns, curfews, UAPA detention, and police raids used for control and intimidation.","evidence":[{"title":"India: Hate Speech Fueled Modi’s Election Campaign","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"14 Aug 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/14/india-hate-speech-fueled-modis-election-campaign","summary":"HRW says the campaign used hate speech and fear-based narratives against Muslims and minorities. For this lens, it is mainly background evidence that coercive state tools operated in a broader environment of communal intimidation.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.3"]},{"title":"India Police Raid Rights Group Delhi","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"4 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/04/india-police-raid-rights-group-delhi","summary":"HRW says Delhi police raided APCR in a politically motivated action tied to criticism of hate speech and detained activists under UAPA. This is direct evidence that anti-terror and security powers were used for intimidation and control of civil society, not narrowly for lawful counterterrorism.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Authorities ‘Missing-in-Action’ Amid Ongoing Violence and Impunity in Manipur State","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"16 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/india-authorities-missing-in-action-amid-ongoing-violence-and-impunity-in-manipur-state-new-testimonies/","summary":"Amnesty says authorities failed to end violence, protect displaced residents, or hold vigilante groups accountable in Manipur. This supports a finding that emergency-style security administration was not narrowly lawful, but instead tolerated collective punishment and impunity.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Internet Suspended in Parts of India’s Manipur as Students Clash with Police","publisher":"Reuters feed via ThePrint","date":"10 Sep 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/internet-suspended-in-parts-of-indias-manipur-as-students-clash-with-police/2261451/","summary":"Reuters reports tear gas, stun grenades, curfews, and internet/mobile shutdowns in response to unrest in Manipur after ethnic violence and security failures. This is strong evidence of administrative controls being used as coercive collective punishment and information control.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"Repression Persists in Jammu and Kashmir","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"31 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/31/india-repression-persists-jammu-and-kashmir","summary":"HRW says security forces continued arbitrary detention, extrajudicial killings, and other abuses with little accountability under draconian laws. This is direct counterevidence that anti-terror and security laws were being used narrowly or lawfully.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Year End Review 2024, Ministry of Home Affairs","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs","date":"30 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2088945&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"The Home Ministry described the new criminal laws as justice-oriented and victim-centric, and highlighted forensic investigation and digital case tools like e-Sakshya and e-Summon. This is the main positive counterpoint, but it is official self-description rather than independent proof that coercive controls were actually constrained.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4"]},{"title":"NHRC India Takes Suo Motu Cognizance of Reported Deaths at Asha Kiran","publisher":"National Human Rights Commission","date":"3 Aug 2024","url":"https://nhrc.nic.in/media/press-release/nhrc-india-takes-suo-motu-cognizance-the-reported-death-12-inmates-within-a-month-in-the-delhi-government-run-shelter-home-asha-kiran-in-rohini","summary":"NHRC took cognizance and asked for a report and action against officials after multiple deaths in a government-run shelter home.
